name: workflow_episode
operational_definition: Bounded instance of AI-assisted or comparator work with one registered objective start end and accountable owner
prohibited_interpretation: A chat session alone is not necessarily an episode

name: organizational_node
operational_definition: Versioned position in enterprise business-unit domain team project workflow hierarchy
prohibited_interpretation: Must not expose personal performance by default

name: registered_outcome_contract
operational_definition: Outcome definition acceptance rule evaluator evidence type and measurement window fixed before episode result
prohibited_interpretation: A post-hoc success description is not a registered contract

name: task_complexity
operational_definition: Pre-action workload characteristics scored without seeing outcome or realized cost
prohibited_interpretation: Realized token count must not define complexity

name: user_or_team_capability
operational_definition: Pre-period experience or validated skill band relevant to the workflow
prohibited_interpretation: Not inferred from AI usage volume

name: workflow_integration
operational_definition: Degree to which AI is embedded in authoritative data tools review and execution steps
prohibited_interpretation: Tool availability alone is not integration

name: ai_access_or_assignment
operational_definition: Eligibility or randomized/quasi-random exposure to AI assistance or an accounting policy
prohibited_interpretation: Observed use is not equivalent to assigned access

name: ai_use_intensity
operational_definition: Calls agent steps or active AI-assisted duration within the episode
prohibited_interpretation: Not productivity or value

name: input_tokens
operational_definition: Provider-reported or tokenizer-estimated uncached input tokens
prohibited_interpretation: Not comparable across models without qualification

name: output_tokens
operational_definition: Provider-reported generated output tokens
prohibited_interpretation: Not a quality measure

name: cached_tokens
operational_definition: Provider-reported cached input or output tokens under a named pricing version
prohibited_interpretation: Not charged identically across providers

name: reasoning_tokens
operational_definition: Provider-exposed reasoning-token quantity when available
prohibited_interpretation: Missing does not mean zero

name: tool_and_retrieval_activity
operational_definition: Versioned tool calls searches retrievals database operations or external actions
prohibited_interpretation: More tool calls do not imply more useful work

name: provider_charge
operational_definition: Reconciled contracted monetary charge for model and hosted AI services
prohibited_interpretation: List price is not contracted charge

name: infrastructure_cost
operational_definition: Allocated compute storage network vector database and platform cost attributable under a stated rule
prohibited_interpretation: Allocation proxy is not exact causal cost

name: human_review_cost
operational_definition: Reviewer time multiplied by a preregistered loaded labor-cost rule
prohibited_interpretation: Time saved elsewhere cannot cancel review cost without evidence

name: rework_cost
operational_definition: Human and system resources required to correct reject or redo AI-assisted work
prohibited_interpretation: Initial completion does not imply zero rework

name: fully_loaded_ai_cost
operational_definition: Provider plus infrastructure tool evaluation human-review integration and rework costs included by the registered boundary
prohibited_interpretation: Not necessarily the organization's complete long-run TCO

name: technical_task_success
operational_definition: Pass or graded score under the registered task acceptance rule
prohibited_interpretation: Technical success is not automatically business value

name: independent_outcome_evidence
operational_definition: Reviewable evidence produced or verified by a source not responsible for the allocation decision or value claim
prohibited_interpretation: Independence must be assessed not assumed

name: human_acceptance
operational_definition: Authorized recipient accepts output for intended use under a predefined rule
prohibited_interpretation: Acceptance is not correctness or incremental value

name: baseline_outcome
operational_definition: Outcome under randomized control pre-period matched comparator or other prespecified identification design
prohibited_interpretation: Historical average is not automatically a credible counterfactual

name: observed_outcome_with_ai
operational_definition: Measured outcome for the AI-assisted episode in the outcome contract's native unit
prohibited_interpretation: Gross outcome is not AI-attributable value

name: incremental_outcome
operational_definition: Observed outcome with AI minus the prespecified counterfactual estimate with uncertainty
prohibited_interpretation: Difference is causal only under identification assumptions

name: attribution_confidence
operational_definition: Prespecified evidence-based confidence in attributing incremental outcome to AI assistance
prohibited_interpretation: Not a subjective certainty score without calibration

name: monetary_value_component
operational_definition: Revenue contribution avoided cost or redeployable cost saving supported by an explicit conversion and evidence
prohibited_interpretation: Time saved is not monetary saving unless capacity is redeployed or avoided

name: nonmonetary_value_component
operational_definition: Quality service resilience learning or risk outcome retained in its native unit
prohibited_interpretation: Must not be silently monetized or summed with currency

name: expected_harm_cost
operational_definition: Probability-weighted adverse consequence under a registered risk model
prohibited_interpretation: A low estimate is not proof of safety

name: verified_incremental_value
operational_definition: Incremental outcome or monetary value supported by evidence baseline attribution confidence and uncertainty record
prohibited_interpretation: Not gross benefit and not guaranteed causal effect

name: outcome_evidence_ledger
operational_definition: Versioned linked record containing consumption work outcome evidence baseline attribution cost value uncertainty and provenance
prohibited_interpretation: A complete form does not ensure truthful evidence

name: decision_receipt
operational_definition: Immutable record of inputs policy version decision rationale approver timestamp and subsequent realized result
prohibited_interpretation: Receipt existence does not imply decision correctness

name: roi_classification
operational_definition: Positive neutral negative or indeterminate classification using registered value cost uncertainty and decision thresholds
prohibited_interpretation: Indeterminate must not be relabeled positive

name: scale_stop_decision
operational_definition: Frozen policy recommendation to stop revise continue pilot or scale
prohibited_interpretation: Recommendation is not evidence of realized future value

name: false_positive_roi
operational_definition: Policy classifies ROI positive when reference evidence classifies non-positive or indeterminate under registered rules
prohibited_interpretation: Depends on reference-label validity

name: false_scale
operational_definition: Policy recommends scale when reference evidence supports stop revise or insufficient evidence
prohibited_interpretation: Not merely a later underperforming project without defined window

name: false_stop
operational_definition: Policy recommends stop when reference evidence supports continued pilot or scale
prohibited_interpretation: Opportunity cost must follow the registered reference rule

name: measurement_cost
operational_definition: Incremental time and money required to populate verify adjudicate and retain the ledger
prohibited_interpretation: Governance is not cost-free

name: allocation_budget
operational_definition: Internal monetary or cost-derived resource envelope available to an organizational node
prohibited_interpretation: Not equivalent to transferable provider credits

name: reserve_carry_forward
operational_definition: Internal balance retained or pooled under a registered expiry risk access and maximum-accumulation rule
prohibited_interpretation: Does not override vendor contract expiry

name: access_exploration_floor
operational_definition: Minimum protected allocation or probability for eligible new uncertain or strategically necessary work
prohibited_interpretation: Not proof of distributive fairness
